description:
Our team is dedicated to exploring the growing challenge of discarded and abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars. As space exploration expands, landers, rovers, instruments, protective materials, and other hardware may remain behind after missions end.

We aim to study this issue from both an environmental and technological perspective, investigating how discarded equipment can affect future exploration, scientific research, and the preservation of extraterrestrial environments. Our team explores innovative approaches for tracking, managing, reusing, recovering, or safely handling space equipment.

Through teamwork, research, creativity, and engineering, we hope to contribute ideas that support responsible and sustainable exploration of the Moon and Mars.
